title: Arbitrary parallel entangling gates with independent calibration on a trapped ion quantum computer
summary: Parallel processing of information plays a critical role in accelerating computation. This includes quantum computers, where parallel processing of quantum information will play a critical role in practical quantum advantage. Here, we demonstrate a new type of parallel entangling gates in a trapped-ion quantum computer, that simultaneously provides efficient gate-pulse synthesis and calibration, as well as graph-pattern-agnostic implementation. We demonstrate the resulting reduced execution time in three well-known algorithms, exhibiting disjoint gates, a star graph and a ring graph…
